note: CODEX DRAFT — NOT CANON. Chapter-one story/play pass after the 2026-09-13 playthrough. English learning targets remain bound to the visible encounter. Ordinary objects regain colour without speaking; devices are inside enchanted school lockers; Merle is helped through six ordered actions; clothes are passive vocabulary finds with no task popup. The ten restoration colours include neutral surfaces whose visible ink curse and measured art are updated with this content. Number-wheel templates retain authored answer pairs; the run chooses consistent variants. Merle rounds and the finale remain ordered.
